title: SSV2
text: SSV2 is a retrieval service that measures its own quality with a labelled benchmark.

title: Health endpoint
text: The health endpoint is a liveness probe. It reports that the process is up and does not load the embedding model.

title: SciFact benchmark
text: SciFact is a non-commercial scientific claim retrieval benchmark and is not shipped inside this image.

title: Embedding model
text: The default embedding model is BAAI bge-small-en version 1.5 and it produces 384-dimensional vectors.
